item.title: New aircraft carrier heads toward Mideast after reports of issues on long-deployed USS Lincoln
item.description: The Pacific-based aircraft carrier USS George Washington has begun heading toward the Middle East as reports have emerged of mental health and supply issues aboard the long-deployed USS Abraham Lincoln.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: Hit hard by the earthquake in western Colombia, the mayor of Cali gets to work
item.description: Search efforts continue though hopes are fading as teams dig for survivors from the 7.4 magnitude earthquake that killed more than 250 people.

item.title: By sky and sea, Ukraine's drone strikes challenge Russia's grip on Crimea
item.description: Russia maintained an iron grip on Crimea since seizing it from Ukraine in 2014. Many Russian civilians go there to enjoy the beaches. But now Ukraine is hitting Crimea hard, upending daily life.

item.title: Millions crowd cities to see Spain's first total solar eclipse in over a century
item.description: As the sky darkened, gradually at first and then quickly, people broke into applause and cheered. It was the Spain's first total solar eclipse in more than a century.

item.title: Photos: See the best photos from this year's total solar eclipse
item.description: Millions of people in Europe stepped outside Wednesday to watch a spectacular sunset with a solar eclipse. The path of totality passed through portions of Greenland, Iceland, Spain and Portugal.
